scenarios.task: Set structural steel beams for a clinic annex expansion adjacent to the occupied Gonstead Clinic in Mount Horeb.
hazards: Pinch points between beam and column
steps: Attend pre-task briefing and confirm lift plan
Connect to anchor points before leaving deck
Guide beam with taglines, keep hands clear of pinch points
Verify bolt-up alignment before releasing load
Complete final connection and inspect
Report near-misses to foreman

rubric.pass_if: Uses taglines and never positions under suspended load
100% tie-off above 6 feet
Uses standard hand signals confirmed with crane operator
Deck clear of loose tools before lift

scenarios.robot_role: Spot carries the lift plan scan and remotely checks under-beam clear zones so workers never place themselves beneath the suspended load.

scenarios.task: Rough-in branch circuit wiring for exam rooms in the clinic annex while building is energized.
steps: Request and verify lockout/tagout on affected circuits
Test for absence of voltage with rated meter
Secure ladder and maintain three points of contact
Pull and staple conductors per code
Ground and bond boxes
Label circuits at panel and request inspection

rubric.pass_if: Applies personal lock and verifies zero energy before work
Conductor sizes, box fill and grounding match plan
Maintains three points of contact and proper ladder angle
All circuits labeled at panel before close-out

scenarios.task: Install copper medical-grade compressed air piping for treatment rooms, braze joints in confined utility corridor.
hazards: Hot work and brazing torch flame
steps: Complete hot work permit and fire watch setup
Purge lines with nitrogen during brazing
Brazing joints to spec, check internal fit-up
Pressure test with inert gas and soap solution
Flush and document system cleanliness
Label valves and record as-builts

rubric.pass_if: Permit posted, fire extinguisher present, watch maintained 30 min after
All joints pass pressure test first time
Confirms ventilation and attendant before entry
Cleanliness and test records completed

scenarios.task: Hand-dig and shore a 6-foot utility trench in clay soil for the clinic water service connection.
steps: Call Diggers Hotline and verify utility locates
Confirm spoil pile set back 2 feet from edge
Enter only after competent person inspects shoring
Hand-dig within tolerance zone of marked lines
Exit trench before any equipment approaches
Report soil changes to competent person immediately

rubric.pass_if: Never enters unprotected trench over 5 feet
Hand-digs within 2 feet of markings
Spoil kept 2+ feet from trench edge
Exits before excavator swings

scenarios.robot_role: Husky tows the shore-box and ferries tools to the trench edge, keeping laborers out of the equipment swing radius.

scenarios.task: Replace a rooftop packaged HVAC unit serving Gonstead Clinic exam rooms during a summer outage window.
steps: Verify LOTO on rooftop disconnect and test
Set up warning line and tie-off points at roof edge
Disconnect and cap old refrigerant lines per EPA rules
Rig old unit off and new unit on with crane signals
Reconnect, evacuate lines, charge and start-up
Verify airflow and temperatures in exam rooms before handover

rubric.pass_if: Locks disconnect and verifies zero voltage
Works within warning line or tied off near edge
Recovers refrigerant with EPA-compliant recovery rig
Documents superheat/subcooling and room temps

scenarios.task: Operate and maintain the high-pressure steam boiler plant serving the clinic through a Wisconsin winter, including burner tune-up.
steps: Review log and previous shift readings
Operate per start-up sequence, watch flame safeguard
Isolate, lock out and cool before opening fireside
Enter only with confined space permit and attendant
Replace nozzle, clean tubes, reassemble and test fires
Log pressures, temperatures and combustion readings

rubric.pass_if: Never bypass flame safeguard or controls
Permit, attendant and atmosphere test before entry
CO and efficiency readings within spec
Log complete and legible for state inspection

scenarios.task: Install rooftop solar array on the clinic parking canopy as a charter measurable-outcome energy project.
hazards: DC arc flash during daytime wiring
Panel loads on hands and back
steps: Assemble rail and confirm waterproof penetrations
Ground racking before setting modules
Cover modules or work dark-side connectors until commissioning
Lift panels in pairs with proper lifting technique
Torque fasteners and verify with checklist
Label disconnects and complete commissioning test

rubric.pass_if: No energized connector handling; modules covered or wired dark
Tied off when within 6 feet of canopy edge
All penetrations flashed and sealed per detail
Torque marks on all fasteners and passing IV curve test

scenarios.robot_role: Go2 ferries connectors and torque wrenches across the canopy deck, reducing trips at the leading edge.

scenarios.task: Install two Level-2 EV chargers in the clinic patient lot, trenching from panel and setting bollards.
steps: Isolate and lock out feeder circuit before tap
Trench, lay conduit, maintain clearances to gas lines
Pull wire, size per charger spec and torque lugs
Set chargers on footings behind bollards
Energize under permit, test ground-fault function
Place traffic cones and signage for reopening
ppe: Arc-flash suit per incident energy analysis

rubric.pass_if: Zero-energy verification before tap and arc-rated PPE per label
Bends, fill and burial depth meet code
Bollards set per spec before energizing
Ground-fault and pilot tests pass before handover
